children.title: POST /api/v2/auditevents
children.summary:
A POST call to this endpoint returns information about actions performed by team
members within a 1Password account.

children.title: Requests
children.summary:
Use the full URL of the auditevents endpoint with your bearer token and the required
request headers.

children.title: Responses
children.summary:
A successful 200 response returns an AuditEventItemsV2 object wrapping cursor
properties and an array of AuditEventV2 objects.
